p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Compare the repeated patterned bands; paint the absent tail in the shorter copy.
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # Repeated rows of the same foreground pattern align within the two bands.
    fg=next(v for v in set(v for r in grid for v in r) if v!=bg)
    active=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if fg in r]
    if len(active)>=2:
        # Matched row profiles: where one row has the same prefix but a shorter run,
        # mark its trailing background cells to the width of the corresponding longer row.
        mid=len(active)//2
        a,b=active[:mid],active[mid:]
        if len(a)==len(b):
            for i,j in zip(a,b):
                n1=max((k+1 for k,x in enumerate(grid[i]) if x==fg),default=0)
                n2=max((k+1 for k,x in enumerate(grid[j]) if x==fg),default=0)
                if n1>n2 and all(x==bg for x in grid[j][n2:n1]):
                    for k in range(n2,n1): out[j][k]=1
    return out
''')
